author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Freshman Tasha Udebhulu scored her first collegiate goal with a little more than 15 minutes remaining, lifting Dartmouth women’s soccer to a 1-0 win over Holy Cross at Burnham Field. The result gave the Big Green a second consecutive victory and stopped a Crusaders team that arrived in Hanover on a four-game winning streak.

The decisive chance began when an attempted clearance by the Holy Cross goalkeeper deflected off Udebhulu just outside the penalty area. The Guildford, England, native collected the loose ball, moved around the goalkeeper and eluded recovering defenders before finishing for the only goal of the match.

Dartmouth improved to 4-1-2 after creating more pressure following halftime. Holy Cross held a 6-3 advantage in shots during the opening half, but the Big Green produced eight attempts in the second. The late breakthrough rewarded that shift while the Dartmouth defense preserved the shutout. The team’s next scheduled match is a Sunday home date with Colgate.
dek: Freshman Tasha Udebhulu broke a scoreless tie late at Burnham Field, giving the Big Green a 1-0 victory and a second straight win.
headline: Udebhulu’s first college goal lifts Dartmouth over Holy Cross
